config.label: Database connection string
config.description: Database connection string. PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, CockroachDB, or a ClickHouse HTTP URL.

config.label: Datasource provider: postgresql, mysql, sqlite, or clickhouse
config.description: Datasource provider: postgresql, mysql, sqlite, or clickhouse. Inferred from DATABASE_URL when omitted.

config.label: Database name
config.description: Database name. Required for ClickHouse, whose URL does not carry one.

config.label: Comma-separated allow-list of tables
config.description: Comma-separated allow-list of tables. When set, only these are exposed to the agent.

config.label: Comma-separated deny-list of tables, applied after the allow-list
config.description: Comma-separated deny-list of tables, applied after the allow-list.

config.label: Path to a policy module that takes full control of access
config.description: Path to a policy module that takes full control of access. Without it, the server is read-only across all tables.

config.label: JSON context object the policy reads, e
config.description: JSON context object the policy reads, e.g. {"tenant":{"id":"acme"}}.

config.label: Serve over Streamable HTTP on this port instead of stdio
config.description: Serve over Streamable HTTP on this port instead of stdio.
